pyFBS.view3D¶

class pyFBS.view3D(show_origin=True, show_axes=True, title=None, **kwargs)[source]¶

A 3D display where structure, impacts, accelerometer and channels can be quickly displayed. The units of the 3D display are in milimeters.

Parameters

  • show_origin (bool, optional) – Display the CSYS in origin

  • show_axes (bool, optional) – Display axes in the bottom left corner

  • title (str, optional) – A title of the 3D display

acc_callback(point, orientation=None)[source]¶

Interactive accelerometer callback function.

Parameters

  • point (array(float)) – Point in 3D space

  • orientation (array(float), optional) – Orientation in 3D space

add_acc_dynamic(mesh, predefined=None)[source]¶

Parameters

  • mesh (array(float)) – A mesh on which to snap

  • predefined (pd.DataFrame, optional) – Predefined set of accelerometers
